key_insight: QPI-DeepONet-MAC combines physics-informed operator learning with a hybrid quantum-classical coupling that preserves universal approximation while improving trainability and stability.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets scalable PDE surrogate modeling for high-dimensional scientific computing, with explicit guidance on sensor count, gradient behavior, and regularization.
method: Injects parameterized quantum circuits into PI-DeepONets via multiplicative-and-additive coupling of classical features and quantum expectation values.
Derives analytical bounds for gradients and scaling to avoid barren plateaus and maintain trainability.
Adds informational regularization using quantum coherence and fidelity dynamics to preserve quantum structure during training.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical results: universal approximation proof, gradient and scaling bounds, a sensor lower bound tied to regularity/dimension/growth, and a coherence-preserving regularizer.
watch_item: The architecture is theoretically grounded, but practical performance will depend on circuit depth, noise, and whether the stated scaling conditions hold on real quantum hardware.
paper_title: QPI-DeepONet-MAC: A Scalable and Stable Hybrid Classical-Quantum Architecture for Physics-Informed Deep Operator Networks
